bundle.longDescription: Looprix is a lightweight Windows desktop app (Tauri + FFmpeg) that streams a pre-recorded video or playlist as YouTube Live via RTMPS. Dual connect (OAuth or manual stream key), Smart Loop, Auto-Reconnect, Presets, Stream Doctor, Overlay, Schedule. Privacy-first: local-only, no cloud, no telemetry. Developed by Bidyut Roy — https://github.com/BidyutRoy2
bundle.shortDescription: Stream a pre-recorded video / playlist as YouTube Live
